# J. Leaders Realty

> Independent real estate brokerage serving western Iowa and the Omaha, Nebraska metro. Licensed in Iowa (firm F06561000) and Nebraska (firm 20230475). Based in Shelby, Iowa. Known for acreages, rural property, small towns and luxury homes, with a dedicated marketing campaign and property website for every listing. Brand: "Lead Different."

Office (call or text): 402.773.8511 · Broker/Owner: Jamie Leaders
Service area: Council Bluffs, Omaha, Elkhorn, Papillion, La Vista, Gretna, Bellevue, Carter Lake, Minden, Neola, Avoca, Shelby, Harlan, Missouri Valley, Underwood, Treynor, Okoboji, and acreages across Pottawattamie, Harrison, Shelby, Mills and Cass counties in Iowa.
Track record: 336+ closed sales (buyers, sellers and investors), $70M+ in total sales, 28 combined years of team experience. 38 acreage and rural sales since 2017.

## Community guides
- [Council Bluffs, IA](https://www.jleadersrealty.org/communities/council-bluffs/): luxury homes, Loess Hills acreages, neighborhoods, schools, monthly market snapshot
- [Minden, IA](https://www.jleadersrealty.org/communities/minden/): new construction after the 2024 tornado, acreages, Tri-Center schools
- [Neola, IA](https://www.jleadersrealty.org/communities/neola/): family neighborhoods, Meyering Addition lots, city housing programs, Arrowhead Park
- [Omaha Metro, NE](https://www.jleadersrealty.org/communities/omaha-metro/): Omaha, Elkhorn, Papillion, La Vista, Gretna and Bellevue; licensed in Nebraska and Iowa; what every J. Leaders listing gets
- [Avoca, IA](https://www.jleadersrealty.org/communities/avoca/): Main Street events, AHSTW schools, pool, library, grocery store; 22 Avoca-area closings
- [Underwood, IA](https://www.jleadersrealty.org/communities/underwood/): I-80 commute, Underwood schools, Loess Hills acreages, Fourth of July at UMBA Hall; 14 Underwood-area closings
- [Shelby, IA](https://www.jleadersrealty.org/communities/shelby/): J. Leaders Realty's home base; AHSTW schools, Carstens Farm Days, Stone Arch Trail, right off I-80; 11 Shelby-area closings
- [Persia, IA](https://www.jleadersrealty.org/communities/persia/): Harrison County town of ~300; Tri-Center schools, Hwy 191, country properties; 12 Persia-area closings incl. an $800K buyer sale
- [Harlan, IA](https://www.jleadersrealty.org/communities/harlan/): Shelby County seat; Harlan native agent Kris Brockhoff; courthouse square, Prairie Rose State Park, Cyclones; sold 3020 Country Club Pkwy for $525,000 (2026)
- [Walnut, IA](https://www.jleadersrealty.org/communities/walnut/): Iowa's Antique City on I-80 Exit 46; Walnut Antique Show (300+ dealers, Father's Day weekend); AHSTW schools; JLR buyer sales incl. $378,900 on Teakwood
- [Treynor, IA](https://www.jleadersrealty.org/communities/treynor/): ~1,000 residents just east of Council Bluffs; Treynor Community Schools (Cardinals); Treynor Days in June
- [Missouri Valley, IA](https://www.jleadersrealty.org/communities/missouri-valley/): Harrison County, I-29 Exit 75 and US 30; DeSoto National Wildlife Refuge; Loess Hills; Big Reds schools
- [Glenwood, IA](https://www.jleadersrealty.org/communities/glenwood/): Mills County seat, courthouse square, Glenwood Lake Park, Rams schools, under 30 min to Omaha; JLR sold 55235 Fox Rd for $650,000
- [Carter Lake, IA](https://www.jleadersrealty.org/communities/carter-lake/): Iowa city on the Nebraska side of the river, lakefront homes, next to Eppley Airfield and downtown Omaha
- [Crescent & Honey Creek, IA](https://www.jleadersrealty.org/communities/crescent/): Loess Hills acreages across the Mormon Bridge from North Omaha; Hitchcock Nature Center; JLR buyer sales $585,000 and $468,800
- [Logan, IA](https://www.jleadersrealty.org/communities/logan/): Harrison County seat on the Lincoln Highway; Logan-Magnolia Panthers; JLR buyer sale $700,000 (2026)
- [Malvern, IA](https://www.jleadersrealty.org/communities/malvern/): Mills County town on the Wabash Trace; Mills County Fair; East Mills schools
- [Western Iowa Acreage Guide](https://www.jleadersrealty.org/acreages/): 12-point acreage checklist (Iowa septic Time of Transfer, wells, rural water, fences, zoning, USDA financing)
